roots.name: Conversation
roots.value: Eat a meal with about 40 g of protein and a moderate amount of carbohydrate two to three hours before lifting. Afterward, have another protein-rich meal within a couple of hours; the exact minute matters far less than hitting the daily total.

ancestor_path.name: Macro targets for cutting phase - ChatGPT

roots.name: Conversation
roots.value: If you train early and cannot stomach a full meal, a banana and a small yogurt thirty minutes beforehand is enough. Keep caffeine to the first half of the day so it does not cut into your sleep.

roots.name: Conversation
roots.value: Plan one flexible meal per weekend rather than a whole free day. Weigh yourself at the same time each morning and judge progress by the weekly average, because daily weight swings of a kilogram are mostly water.

ancestor_path.name: Macro targets for cutting phase - ChatGPT

roots.name: Conversation
roots.value: Review the trend every two weeks. If your average weight has not moved after fourteen days, trim about 100 kcal from carbohydrates rather than cutting protein.
